title: DesKit Marketplace registry entry
description: One published plugin listing. Lives at plugins/<id>.json.

id.description: Reverse-DNS plugin id, e.g. com.alice.weather. Must match the manifest id and the filename.

name.description: Short machine-ish name (matches the plugin manifest name).

homepage.description: Plugin source repository or landing page (https only).

version.description: Semver of this listing. Re-publishing requires a new version + new PR.

downloadUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the prebuilt .deskit GitHub Release asset. The client downloads this directly; it must NOT point at source that needs building.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the .deskit asset. The client refuses a download whose hash differs.

deskitEngine.description: Semver range of DesKit versions this plugin supports, e.g. ^0.2.0.

categories.description: Optional free-form tags for filtering in the marketplace UI.

iconReference.description: Optional listing icon. Use lucide:<name> for bundled Lucide icons, or a packaged relative image path.

iconImagePath.description: Relative image path packaged inside the plugin .deskit archive.
